metadata.description: Read the user-supplied request.json, which contains term and may contain from_date and limit.

blocks.block_name: Call index.search once with the request parameters

constraints: Use request.term unchanged as the query argument.
When from_date is present, pass its value unchanged; the accepted format is YYYY-MM-DD.
When from_date is missing, omit the from_date argument.
When limit is present, pass its value unchanged as the limit argument.
When limit is missing, omit the limit argument.

blocks.block_name: Write total to count.txt and return items

constraints: Write the response's total value to local count.txt.
Return the search response's items value unchanged.
